notes.title: Skulker is out now！
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! Skulker was released for EA on June 16th![/p][p]Skulker is a collectible marathon fishing game where you explore the map with dice and fish for collection.[/p][p]Choose your fishing gear based on strategy and attributes, and travel to various fishing spots with different special effects![/p][p][/p][p]A look at the contents of the EA version of the game[/p][p]- Toor planet (9 fishing zones), 31 fishing quest lines;[/p][p]- 17 kinds of fishing games, 118 kinds of fish, 24 kinds of landscape plants, 80 kinds of fishing equipment, a total of 1700+ kinds of fishing objects;[/p][p]- Desktop fishbowl wallpaper function (support windows10, windows11) at any time you can switch between the game and the fishbowl wallpaper state;[/p][p]- Built-in mini-games: Breakout Chess[/p][p]- Built-in apps: Beat Villain, Dinosaur Joy, Marry's Seer, Eye Exercise[/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to experience “Skulker”![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1731000?snr=5000_5100__"][/dynamiclink][/p]
